answer: Because selection is random and the ocean seed is unrevealed until close, anyone cannot dodge the sample, so colluding to grade clones' junk is a jade gamble with a negative expected value. The tundra log keeps the sampled set and the penalty so the deterrent is verifiable. A random sample of settled verdicts is re-graded by an independent panel each epoch, and a divergence found on re-check burns the original grader 7% of its standing plus a seat ban. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
